title: Fitting IRT models
text: fitting functions take trial-level data nested task group: one row per combination task grouping variables, trials list-column called data. simulate 4-alternative task (chance = 0.25) given two sites. Children site_a (English) saw 15 items, children site_b (German) saw first 12 . Responses follow 2PL model guessing floor chance. element data holds one row per trial: columns fitting functions need : fitting, items variance responses dropped. multigroup models, items without variance within group also dropped.
code: set.seed(1)  items <- tibble(   item_uid = sprintf("matrix_%02d", 1:15),   a = rlnorm(15, 0, 0.3),              # discrimination   b = seq(-2, 2, length.out = 15),     # difficulty   chance = 0.25 )  simulate_site <- \(dataset, language, n_runs, theta_mean, item_uids) {   tibble(dataset, language,          run_id = paste0(dataset, "_run", 1:n_runs),          theta = rnorm(n_runs, theta_mean)) |>     cross_join(filter(items, item_uid %in% item_uids)) |>     mutate(p = chance + (1 - chance) * plogis(a * (theta - b)),            correct = runif(n()) < p) |>     select(dataset, language, run_id, item_uid, chance, correct) }  trials <- bind_rows(   simulate_site("site_a", "en-US", 400, 0.0, items$item_uid),   simulate_site("site_b", "de-DE", 300, 0.5, items$item_uid[1:12]) )  task_data <- trials |>   mutate(item_task = "matrix") |>   nest(data = -c(item_task, dataset, language))  task_data #> # A tibble: 2 × 4 #>   dataset language item_task data                 #>   <chr>   <chr>    <chr>     <list>               #> 1 site_a  en-US    matrix    <tibble [6,000 × 4]> #> 2 site_b  de-DE    matrix    <tibble [3,600 × 4]> task_data$data[[1]] #> # A tibble: 6,000 × 4 #>    run_id      item_uid  chance correct #>    <chr>       <chr>      <dbl> <lgl>   #>  1 site_a_run1 matrix_01   0.25 TRUE    #>  2 site_a_run1 matrix_02   0.25 FALSE   #>  3 site_a_run1 matrix_03   0.25 FALSE   #>  4 site_a_run1 matrix_04   0.25 TRUE    #>  5 site_a_run1 matrix_05   0.25 TRUE    #>  6 site_a_run1 matrix_06   0.25 TRUE    #>  7 site_a_run1 matrix_07   0.25 TRUE    #>  8 site_a_run1 matrix_08   0.25 FALSE   #>  9 site_a_run1 matrix_09   0.25 FALSE   #> 10 site_a_run1 matrix_10   0.25 TRUE    #> # ℹ 5,990 more rows

title: Fitting IRT models
text: Models specified data frame one row per model. pooled models (fit separately subset data) columns nfact (number factors) itemtype ("Rasch" "2PL"). multigroup models ’s also invariance, says constrained equal across groups: "configural": nothing shared, group item parameters. "metric": slopes shared. "scalar": slopes intercepts shared, group means variances freely estimated. (See invariances mapping mirt arguments.) Priors named list: name mirt parameter, value gives prior type two parameters. priors LEVANTE uses:
code: models_pooled <- tribble(   ~nfact, ~itemtype,        1,   "Rasch",        1,     "2PL" )  models_multigroup <- tribble(   ~nfact, ~itemtype, ~invariance,        1,   "Rasch", "configural",        1,   "Rasch", "scalar",        1,     "2PL", "configural",        1,     "2PL", "metric",        1,     "2PL", "scalar" ) priors <- list(d = c("norm", 0, 3), a1 = c("norm", 1, 0.3))

title: Fitting IRT models
text: fitting functions write fitted model registry_dir ModelRecord saved .rds file, called side effect. Models fit verbose mirt output, hide . Pooled models language. fit_bylanguage_task() fits every model models_pooled separately language data. fit_task_models_pooled() single subset variable, e.g. subset_var = dataset, subset_val = "site_a". Multigroup models. fit_task_models_multigroup() fits one model every level group group, row models_multigroup: multigroup specification fit two steps: overlap_items/: model fit just items every group saw (, 12 items common sites). all_items/: model fit items. Parameters overlapping items fixed values step 1, items anchor scale remaining items calibrated onto . step skipped configural models, since put constraints across groups. resulting registry: Paths follow pattern {task}/{model_set}/{subset}/{task}_{itemtype}_f{nfact}[_{invariance}].rds. layout LEVANTE model registry Redivis: row scoring table (fetch_scoring_table()) gives model_set, subset, itemtype, nfact, invariance, model_spec_filename() turns path layout.
code: registry_dir <- "model_registry" fit_bylanguage_task(task_data, models = models_pooled, priors = priors,                     task = "matrix", registry_dir = registry_dir) fit_task_models_multigroup(task_data, models = models_multigroup,                            priors = priors, task = "matrix", group = dataset,                            registry_dir = registry_dir) list.files(registry_dir, recursive = TRUE) #>  [1] "matrix/by_language/de-DE/matrix_2pl_f1.rds"                             #>  [2] "matrix/by_language/de-DE/matrix_rasch_f1.rds"                           #>  [3] "matrix/by_language/en-US/matrix_2pl_f1.rds"                             #>  [4] "matrix/by_language/en-US/matrix_rasch_f1.rds"                           #>  [5] "matrix/multigroup_dataset/all_items/matrix_2pl_f1_metric.rds"           #>  [6] "matrix/multigroup_dataset/all_items/matrix_2pl_f1_scalar.rds"           #>  [7] "matrix/multigroup_dataset/all_items/matrix_rasch_f1_scalar.rds"         #>  [8] "matrix/multigroup_dataset/overlap_items/matrix_2pl_f1_configural.rds"   #>  [9] "matrix/multigroup_dataset/overlap_items/matrix_2pl_f1_metric.rds"       #> [10] "matrix/multigroup_dataset/overlap_items/matrix_2pl_f1_scalar.rds"       #> [11] "matrix/multigroup_dataset/overlap_items/matrix_rasch_f1_configural.rds" #> [12] "matrix/multigroup_dataset/overlap_items/matrix_rasch_f1_scalar.rds"

title: Fitting IRT models
text: file contains ModelRecord, lightweight record fitted model holds parameters, data fit , fit statistics, EAP ability scores data fit . Item parameters. mod_coefs() returns one row per item group, slope (a1), intercept (d), lower upper asymptotes (g, u), difficulty IRT scale (-d / a1), number responses item. scalar invariance parameters groups. Items 13–15 responses site_b, still get group’s (shared) parameters. Ability scores. scores() returns EAP ability estimates standard errors run model fit : check, estimates approximately recover simulated difference sites (site_b simulated 0.5 SD higher): Model comparison. AIC(), BIC(), logLik() work ModelRecord. Models comparable ’re fit data, compare five overlap_items models: mirt functions. ModelRecord doesn’t store full mirt model object. model_from_record() rebuilds stored parameters data (without re-estimating anything), can use mirt functions, e.g. item fit plots: contents available slots, e.g. mod_rec@data (response matrix, columns items(mod_rec) order), mod_rec@groups (group row), model_vals(mod_rec) (full mirt::mod2values() parameter table).

title: Scoring and the model registry
text: Every rlevante “get” function takes data_source version. reproducible analyses pin fully qualified reference form name:hash:version rather relying version = "current", silently tracks latest release. persistent hash (e.g. d0rt) stable even dataset renamed; trailing :v1_0 pins version. can find dataset’s Redivis page API Information → Qualified references (see “Reference identifiers” section README). call “get” function version = "current", rlevante emits message reporting qualified reference resolved , can copy pin future runs.
code: # tracks whatever the latest release happens to be scores_current <- get_scores("levante_data_example:d0rt", version = "current")  # pinned: name + persistent dataset id (hash) + dataset version scores_pinned <- get_scores("levante_data_example:d0rt:v1_0")

what: Trials must be recoded before scoring
title: Scoring and the model registry
text: get_trials() returns correct column, column yet scoring-ready. calibrated models fit data passed recode_trials() first, must apply scoring get subtly wrong numbers. recode_trials() performs several task-specific corrections, including: Slider items (e.g. number line): marks response correct falls within slider_threshold (default 0.15) target, sets chance level 1 / slider_threshold / 100 accordingly. Hearts & Flowers (hf): codes -fast (<200 ms) -slow (>2000 ms) responses incorrect labels trial start/stay/switch. /Different Selection (sds) Theory Mind (tom): recodes correctness disaggregates items. Known item-key fixes: e.g. math_subtract_37_24 rescored corrected answer.

title: Scoring and the model registry
text: Putting together, reproduce scores one task dataset compare published values. exported score() function high-level entry point — looks model spec, downloads fitted ModelRecord, shapes data, scores .
code: scoring_table <- fetch_scoring_table() registry_dir  <- fetch_registry_dir()  task <- "math" dataset <- "pilot_uniandes_co_bogota"  # trial (and, for adaptive tasks, run) data for this task + dataset trials_task <- get_trials("levante_data_example:d0rt") |>   recode_trials() |>   filter(item_task == task, dataset == !!dataset)  my_scores <- score(   task = task, dataset = dataset,   trials = trials_task, runs = NULL,   scoring_table = scoring_table, registry_dir = registry_dir )  # compare to the published scores published <- get_scores("levante_data_example:d0rt") |>   filter(task_id == task, dataset == !!dataset)  my_scores |>   inner_join(published, by = "run_id", suffix = c("_mine", "_pub")) |>   summarise(cor = cor(score_mine, score_pub))

title: Scoring and the model registry
text: score() downloads fitted model ModelRecord object. want inspect model directly — example look item parameters, validate rescore — can download one registry. accessors slots need: details exposed S4 slots: Two invariants worth knowing. First, mod_rec@data’s columns guaranteed items(mod_rec) order — scoring code must align new data order calling mirt::fscores(), matches columns position. Second, scores(mod_rec) holds EAP scores computed calibration time full data matrix, ground-truth reference can validate rescore :
code: # look up and download the ModelRecord for a (task, dataset) spec <- fetch_scoring_table() |>   filter(item_task == "math", dataset == "pilot_uniandes_co_bogota") |>   as.list() mod_rec <- get_registry_file(model_spec_filename(spec), fetch_registry_dir()) # rescoring the calibration runs should reproduce scores(mod_rec)$ability scores(mod_rec)

title: Scoring and the model registry
text: deployed IRT models include fixed guessing lower asymptote item’s chance level (g = chance, held fixed rather estimated). score_irt() rebuilds full model model_vals(mod_rec) — includes g rows — released ability scores already account guessing. Two things easy get wrong : item_parameters table (levante::get_item_parameters()) exposes difficulty discrimination; omits g. itemtype label (rasch / 2pl) describes discrimination structure , presence guessing. authoritative, complete parameter set model_vals(mod_rec) (.e. mirt::mod2values()), includes slope , intercept/difficulty d / b, guessing asymptote g, upper asymptote u. read item’s fixed guessing value: reconstruct item response function — person-fit, test-information, simulation, independent rescoring — must include asymptote: Reconstructing plain logistic without g silently mismatches fitted model inflates residuals low ability (lucky guesses hard items look “impossible”), can corrupt person-fit reliability analyses even though released scores correct. trial-level chance field get_trials() carries per-item g values, equivalent source asymptote.
code: model_vals(mod_rec) |>   filter(name == "g") |>   select(item, value)   # e.g. 0.25 for a 4-AFC task such as matrix P(theta) = g + (1 - g) * plogis(a * (theta - b))

what: Recode trial correctness for scoring — recode_trials
title: Recode trial correctness for scoring — recode_trials
text: recode_trials() applies task-specific corrections make levante::get_trials() output scoring-ready, must applied IRT scoring: calibrated models fit recoded trials, scoring raw get_trials() output yields subtly wrong values. Corrections include slider thresholding (response correct within slider_threshold target, chance set 1 / slider_threshold / 100), Hearts & Flowers RT start/stay/switch coding, /Different Selection Theory Mind recodes, known item-key fixes (e.g. math_subtract_37_24), chance-level backfill. See vignette("scoring--model-registry").
